selected_architecture.summary: Under the exact observed fragile-query-path stress, use surviving teacher-blind reservations as local source anchors, generate only immediate same-page proposition neighbors, rank those neighbors by surviving frozen retrieval-path evidence, restore the vacated slot, and preserve the already validated alignment swap.

scientific_question: Is the remaining e1.a fragility caused by proposition-level pruning that can be repaired by deterministic local source-neighborhood expansion around already-selected unflagged evidence, or does it require deeper/global evidence allocation or a genuinely adaptive retrieval mechanism?

established: COMPOSED_COMPLEMENTARITY_FRAGILE reaches 9/13 at exact budget28 with e1.a, e6.a, and all seven frozen controls; therefore acquisition and alignment preservation are mechanically compatible.
The frozen flagged-origin sensitivity removes page:p2:s33 and leaves 8/13 with e6.a plus all seven controls; only e1.a is lost.
Only source-aware method intent 0 is flagged by the frozen teacher anti-leak audit.

The surviving unflagged author-contribution intent 3 already exposes the first e1.a anchor at BM25 rank1 and the second e1.a anchor at rank10; complete e1.a evidence is therefore present in frozen automatic retrieval without generating a new query.
The surviving budget28 author reservation page:p2:s32 and the fragile missing proposition page:p2:s33 are adjacent propositions on the same authoritative PDF page.
NLI_CERTIFICATE_REJECTED, PREDICATE_ARGUMENT_CERTIFICATE_REJECTED, and AMR_GRAPH_CERTIFICATE_REJECTED remain negative evidence against pairwise semantic redundancy certificates.

residual_hypotheses.statement: The robustness failure is primarily a proposition-level pruning/context-boundary error: a surviving high-confidence reservation lands next to the missing evidence, and a bounded local-neighborhood rescue can recover it without a new query.
residual_hypotheses.predicted_observation: After the exact flagged-path stress removes page:p2:s33, a teacher-blind immediate-neighbor rescue restores a candidate that yields e1.a while the frozen alignment mechanism keeps e6.a and all seven controls at fixed budget28.

residual_hypotheses.statement: The evidence is retrievable by an unflagged frozen query but immediate local context is insufficient or not selected; the real residual is how much depth or evidence budget to allocate within an intent.
residual_hypotheses.predicted_observation: The frozen rescue candidate pool contains no candidate that restores e1.a, despite the known unflagged rank10 exposure.

residual_hypotheses.statement: A static local expansion rule cannot reliably identify the missing evidence; the next mechanism must explicitly detect missing facets/information and adapt retrieval or evidence allocation.
residual_hypotheses.predicted_observation: Local-neighborhood rescue fails while deeper frozen evidence remains known to exist, motivating a gap-directed planner rather than new query generation by default.

residual_hypotheses.statement: New query generation is not yet justified because the missing evidence already exists under a surviving frozen query path.
residual_hypotheses.predicted_observation: Any successful local or depth-based rescue further weakens query-generation deficiency as the primary residual.

mechanism_family_comparison.rationale: Smallest mechanism that directly tests the observed adjacency/context-pruning hypothesis. It requires zero generation/model calls and one deterministic slot replacement under the already-frozen robustness stress.

The unflagged author intent exposes complete e1.a only by depth10, so deeper within-intent allocation is plausible. It is deferred because blindly increasing depth/budget is more expensive and less diagnostic than first testing the adjacent-source rescue.
Evidence that survives multiple query paths is a plausible robustness signal, but it introduces a new global ranking rule. Local rescue is smaller and directly grounded in the current failure.
Adaptive retrieval is appropriate if static local/depth mechanisms fail, but it requires a new sufficiency/gap controller and is not the smallest current test.
Existing frozen unflagged intent 3 already exposes the complete e1.a evidence by depth10; generating new queries would not test the smallest remaining premise.
Repeated NLI, dependency predicate/argument, and AMR certificate failures remain negative evidence against reopening this family.

external_research_evidence.source: Perçin et al. Investigating the Robustness of Retrieval-Augmented Generation at the Query Level. GEM 2025.
external_research_evidence.lesson: Retriever output can change sharply under modest query perturbations, motivating explicit path-robustness evaluation instead of assuming one query formulation is stable.

external_research_evidence.source: Verma et al. NEST: Nested Evidence Survival for Retrieval. ACL Industry 2026.
external_research_evidence.lesson: Separating recall amplification from precision selection and rescuing evidence pruned by static retrieval contexts supports a bounded local-context survival test before introducing iterative control or model scaling.

external_research_evidence.source: Banerjee et al. The Bottleneck Is Retrieval, Not Reading. Findings EMNLP 2026.
external_research_evidence.lesson: Similarity retrieval often surfaces some relevant evidence but fails to surface all evidence required for multi-fact questions; chunking/context boundaries can discard relations needed across nearby evidence.

external_research_evidence.source: Singh et al. SPLADE-COVER: Coverage-Aware Representations for Learned Sparse Retrieval. EMNLP 2026.
external_research_evidence.lesson: Long-form retrieval benefits from explicit multi-aspect coverage rather than a single relevance score; this supports coverage-aware evidence rescue as a distinct mechanism family, while the learned model itself is not adopted here.

external_research_evidence.source: Ammann et al. Question Decomposition for Retrieval-Augmented Generation. ACL SRW 2025.
external_research_evidence.lesson: Subquery-specific retrieval can improve distributed evidence coverage, but EXTRACT already has a surviving query path to the missing evidence, so new decomposition is deferred until cheaper rescue mechanisms are falsified.

selected_discriminating_experiment.purpose: Under the exact previously observed flagged-origin stress that removes page:p2:s33, test whether a teacher-blind local-neighborhood backfill from surviving salience reservations can restore e1.a at fixed budget28 while preserving e6.a and all seven frozen controls.

stressed_intent.origin: Exact sole flagged intent from the already-frozen teacher anti-leak audit. It is not used to generate or rank rescue candidates.

frozen_inputs.teacher_use: Teacher data defines only the already-frozen stress condition and evaluates the final set. Teacher atoms/anchors may not generate the neighborhood, rank candidates, choose a rescue candidate, alter the budget, or tune any rule.

steps: Load the exact composed 28-proposition set from run 40139717644 and verify report/artifact identity.
Reproduce the exact frozen flagged-origin sensitivity by removing page:p2:s33 with no backfill, yielding the known 27-proposition stressed set.
Identify surviving non-core salience-stratified reservation propositions in their exact original frontier order. The validated-alignment proposition is not a rescue seed.

For each surviving reservation seed, generate at most its immediate predecessor and immediate successor proposition on the same authoritative PDF page, excluding already-selected propositions and crossing no page boundary.
For every unique neighbor candidate, inspect only the frozen BM25 top12 rankings of the four surviving tier1 intents. No new retrieval query or model call is allowed.

Assign candidate structural support_count = number of surviving tier1 intents whose top12 contains the candidate; best_rank = best BM25 rank among those paths. Candidates absent from all surviving top12 rankings are ineligible.
Rank eligible neighbors by support_count descending, best_rank ascending, seed frontier rank ascending, neighbor distance (always 1), predecessor before successor, then proposition_id ascending.
Append exactly the top-ranked eligible neighbor to restore the set to exactly 28 propositions. No further backfill or retry is allowed.
Evaluate frozen teacher support only after the rescued set is fixed.

frozen_controls: COMPOSED_COMPLEMENTARITY_FRAGILE primary: 9/13 with e1.a+e6.a+7 controls at budget28.
Exact flagged-origin sensitivity: 8/13 with e6.a+7 controls and e1.a absent after page:p2:s33 removal.
Unflagged author-contribution intent 3: e1.a first anchor rank1, second anchor rank10, complete depth10.
ALIGNMENT_AUGMENT_FEASIBLE: e6.a recovered with all seven controls preserved.

mechanism: seed proposition/frontier rank for each candidate
whether chosen candidate is adjacent to a surviving author/source reservation
cost_provenance: incremental raw source chars vs immutable top24
all selected propositions exactly locatable to authoritative PDF page/proposition identity

LOCAL_RESCUE_CONFIRMED: The exact stressed set is restored to budget28 by one teacher-blind eligible local neighbor.
All seven frozen controls remain supported.
Both e1.a and e6.a are supported, yielding >=9/13.
Interpretation: the observed robustness failure is a local proposition-pruning/context-boundary error; immediate source-neighborhood rescue is sufficient under the known stress.
LOCAL_RESCUE_PARTIAL: The rescue completes safely and preserves all seven controls, e1.a is restored, but e6.a is no longer supported.

Interpretation: immediate local rescue repairs the fragile e1.a acquisition path but interferes with the independently validated e6.a preservation outcome; next compare a joint robust reservation/preservation policy against deeper per-intent allocation.
LOCAL_RESCUE_NEGATIVE: The rescue completes safely and preserves all seven controls, but e1.a remains unsupported regardless of whether e6.a remains supported.

Interpretation: immediate adjacency is insufficient to repair the known e1.a fragility despite known deeper unflagged exposure; next test deeper per-intent allocation or retrieval-path survival before adaptive gap planning.
LOCAL_RESCUE_NO_ELIGIBLE_NEIGHBOR: No immediate neighbor of any surviving reservation seed appears in the frozen top12 of any surviving tier1 intent.
Interpretation: reject local-neighborhood rescue premise; move to deeper/global evidence allocation.
LOCAL_RESCUE_COLLISION: A valid rescue causes loss of one or more frozen control atoms.
Interpretation: the rescue violates preservation and is rejected.
INVALID_EXECUTION: Any exact input, sensitivity replay, proposition-neighborhood identity, fixed-budget, provenance, or teacher-boundary check fails.
Interpretation: no scientific verdict; repair only unchanged replay/identity mechanics with fresh explicit recovery authority.

selected_discriminating_experiment.stopping_rule: Exactly one valid scientific execution after independent design review. Stop at LOCAL_RESCUE_CONFIRMED, LOCAL_RESCUE_PARTIAL, LOCAL_RESCUE_NEGATIVE, LOCAL_RESCUE_NO_ELIGIBLE_NEIGHBOR, or LOCAL_RESCUE_COLLISION. INVALID_EXECUTION is operational/no-verdict. No changes to the stress identity, surviving intents, depth12, adjacency rule, structural ranking, one-slot budget, teacher use, metrics, or interpretation after seeing a result.

pass_authority.LOCAL_RESCUE_CONFIRMED: Authorize a later bounded design that generalizes neighborhood-aware acquisition robustness beyond the one control paper and compares its cost against deeper-per-intent allocation. No production promotion.
pass_authority.LOCAL_RESCUE_PARTIAL: Authorize only a direct comparison of deeper per-intent allocation versus robust structural reservation; do not expand neighborhood radius post hoc.
pass_authority.LOCAL_RESCUE_NEGATIVE: Reject immediate-neighbor rescue and test deeper per-intent allocation/retrieval-path survival. New query generation remains deferred because frozen unflagged evidence exists at depth10.
pass_authority.LOCAL_RESCUE_NO_ELIGIBLE_NEIGHBOR: Reject local-neighborhood premise and move to deeper/global evidence allocation.
